config.description:
Configuration for the key-auth auth strategy.
For advanced use cases, additional config properties can be sent in the
request body.
See: https://developer.konghq.com/plugins/key-auth/reference/ for the list
of properties

hideCredentials.description:
An optional boolean value telling the plugin to show or hide the credential
from the upstream service.
If true, the plugin strips the credential from the request.

keyInBody.description:
If enabled, reads the request body.
Supported MIME types: application/www-form-urlencoded, application/json, and
multipart/form-data.

keyInHeader.description:
If enabled (default), the plugin reads the request header and tries to find
the key in it.

keyInQuery.description:
If enabled (default), the plugin reads the query parameter in the request
and tries to find the key in it.

keyNames.description:
An array of strings containing the names of the keys to look for in the
request.

principals.description:
Authenticate against Kong Identity instead of local credentials.
Mutually exclusive with identity realms.

directory.description: The Kong Identity directory instance to authenticate against.

enabled.description: When true, authenticate against Kong Identity instead of local credentials.

errorOnMiss.description:
When true (default), reject the request if no matching principal is found in
Kong Identity.
When false, allow the request to continue unauthenticated instead.

displayName.description: The display name for this auth strategy instance.

labels.description:
Public labels store information about an entity that can be used for
filtering a list of objects.

Public labels are intended to store **PUBLIC** metadata.

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong",
"konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".

additionalProperties.description: PublicLabelsValue is the value type for PublicLabels.

managedBy.description:
Stores information about what manages this entity, such as the tool or
system responsible for its lifecycle (for example, `terraform`).

Keys must be 1–63 characters long and start with an alphanumeric
character.

additionalProperties.description: ManagedByValue is the value type for ManagedBy.

config.description:
Configuration for the OpenID Connect auth strategy.
For advanced use cases, additional config properties can be sent in the
request body.
See: https://developer.konghq.com/plugins/openid-connect/reference/ for the
list of properties

audienceRequired.description: Audiences required in the access token or introspection response.

cacheTokensSalt.description:
Salt used for generating the cache key that is used for caching the token
endpoint requests.

clientAlg.description:
Algorithm to use for `client_secret_jwt` or `private_key_jwt`
authentication.

clientAuth.description: Client authentication methods used with the identity provider.

clientID.description:
An array of strings representing the client id for the OpenID Connect
provider.
When multiple values are provided, the client ID and secrets pairs
correspond based on their locations in the array.

clientSecret.description:
An array of strings representing the client secret for the OpenID Connect
provider.
When multiple values are provided, the client ID and secrets pairs
correspond based on their locations in the array.

items.description:
SensitiveDataSource holds a sensitive string value that can be provided
either inline or sourced from a Kubernetes Secret.

secretRef.description:
SecretRef is a reference to a Kubernetes Secret containing the sensitive data.
Required when type is 'secretRef'.

key.description: Key is the data key within the Secret.

name.description: Name is the name of the referred resource.

namespace.description:
Namespace is the namespace of the referred resource.

For namespace-scoped resources if no Namespace is provided then the
namespace of the parent object MUST be used.

This field MUST not be set when referring to cluster-scoped resources.

type.description: Type indicates the source of the sensitive data: 'inline' or 'secretRef'.

value.description:
Value contains the sensitive data provided inline.
Required when type is 'inline'.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: value required when type=inline; secretRef required when type=secretRef

consumerBy.description: Consumer fields used when mapping a token claim to a Kong consumer.

consumerClaims.description:
An array containing an array of string paths representing the location of
the claim in a nested object.
For example, to map to user.info.id, set [ "user", "info", "id" ].

consumerGroupsClaim.description:
The claim used for consumer groups mapping.
If multiple values are set, it means the claim is inside a nested object of
the token payload.

consumerGroupsOptional.description: Do not terminate the request if consumer groups mapping fails.

consumerOptional.description: Do not terminate the request if consumer mapping fails.

credentialClaim.description:
Claim path used to derive virtual credentials when consumer mapping is not
used.

hideCredentials.description:
Remove credentials used for authentication before proxying the request
upstream.

httpProxy.description: HTTP proxy used for identity provider requests.

httpProxyAuthorization.description: Authorization header value sent to the HTTP proxy.

httpVersion.description: HTTP version used for identity provider requests.

httpsProxy.description: HTTPS proxy used for identity provider requests.

httpsProxyAuthorization.description: Authorization header value sent to the HTTPS proxy.

introspectionEndpoint.description: Overrides the introspection endpoint returned by discovery.

issuer.description: URL that identifies the OpenID Provider

jwksEndpoint.description: Overrides the JWKS endpoint returned by discovery.

keepalive.description: Reuse HTTP client connections for identity provider requests.

leeway.description: Leeway, in seconds, for validating token time claims.

mtlsIntrospectionEndpoint.description: mTLS alias for the introspection endpoint.

noProxy.description: Comma-separated hosts that bypass the configured proxies.

principals.description: Map a request to a Kong Identity principal after token verification.

directory.description: The Kong Identity directory instance to look up against.

enabled.description: When true, look up a Kong Identity principal after token verification.

errorOnMiss.description:
When true (default), reject the request if no principal is matched in Kong
Identity after token
verification.
When false, the request continues without an authenticated principal set.

matchConsumer.description:
If a consumer is attached to the matched principal, load it and set it in
the request context,
overriding consumer_by.

matchConsumerGroups.description:
If consumer groups are attached to the matched principal, load them,
overriding consumer_groups_claim.

principalBy.description:
Custom identity name for a custom Kong Identity lookup.
When absent and principal_claim is set,
a lookup is performed using principal_claim as the claim name instead of the
default sub claim.

principalClaim.description:
Token claim used for the Kong Identity lookup.
If multiple values are set, the claim is inside a
nested object of the token payload.
Used together with, or instead of, principal_by.

timeout.description: Network I/O timeout, in milliseconds, for identity provider requests.

upstreamHeaders.description: Map token claims to upstream headers using path-based access.

items.description:
